'''JS-25''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that dwelled in the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-run settlement [[X2-4]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. JS-25 had [[Computer/Legends|computer]]-repair capabilities and after Uffel's [[MSF mouse droid]] production line was sabotaged by the rogue droid [[LN-73]] in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], JS-25 and fellow protocol droid [[Y-2D0]] were sent to re-program the production line's systems.
